purpose: Inspect a selected vehicle's current layered live-signal snapshot, source distribution, value kinds and individual raw values.
primaryGoal: Diagnose missing, stale or noisy signals using a one-second foreground snapshot poll, provenance, value ages and searchable details without confusing transport health with measurement freshness.

dataSources.sourceOwner: signalinspect.Handler.LiveState; router wires existing RedisSignalCache and live signal store
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['live-signals', vehicleId]; enabled only for a truthy vehicle ID and page enablement. AbortSignal is forwarded. Page requests refetchInterval=1000; hook sets matching staleTime through queryPolicy('live'), whose background polling is false. Retry remains QueryClient-owned. No historical window or new endpoint is needed.
dataSources.payload: VehicleLiveSignalsResponse contains optional vehicle_id, count, at and signals; each signal may be an envelope with value/kind/source/age_ms/timestamp/ts or a bare value. The page derives counts from actual entries rather than response.count.
dataSources.backendLimits: Route registration and injected owners inspected only. Handler execution, actual availability, response freshness, cache topology and per-signal physical units were not exercised.

dataSources.behavior: Selection precedence is path ID, vehicle_id query parameter, persisted selection, first known vehicle. Selection writes URL/store and clears a competing VIN override only on deliberate selection. Vehicles are null-safe arrays; resolved stale IDs are repaired. Fleet query loading/error metadata is not returned by useSelectedVehicle.

dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing singleton sseManager connection state and heartbeat; not the live snapshot polling query
dataSources.behavior: Global SSE connected/reconnecting/disconnected/unknown status; reconnect grace is 10 seconds. This is a separate wire-health source and not proof of selected-vehicle snapshot freshness.
dataSources.backendLimits: SSE manager endpoint was not traced; no endpoint guessed.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Source and kind panels repeat GlassPanel padding, icon/title and LiveSectionState composition. Table is also nested inside GlassPanel with the DataTable standalone default.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse current Section/LayoutCard/ChartCard where exact composition preserves contents; use DataTable variant='embedded' inside its existing host panel. Do not introduce a new LivePanel abstraction solely for two siblings.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Compact age formatting exists here and separately in SourceLayerBadge.tsx:75-82. The table subscribes to useNumberFormatting without using its returned formatter; the brief intentionally retains this specialist age formatter.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse established locale-aware duration/number owners where equivalent. Retain raw ms and exact specialist notation until equivalence is demonstrated; do not invent another converter.

sourceEvidence: Page actions wrap; toolbar is w-full sm:w-56 (page:75-81; LiveSignalToolbar.tsx:59).
Breakdowns stack below xl and become three columns at xl, with source panel spanning two (page:124-128; LiveSignalSourceBreakdown.tsx:85).
Four source tiles use two columns then four at sm (LiveSignalSourceBreakdown.tsx:127).
Table retains min-w-0 and max-w-md search. Only name/value are allowed on mobile (LiveSignalsTable.tsx:76,114,126,217).

issues.detail: mobileColumns=['name','value'] hides kind/source/last-update below md. DataTable implements this as hidden md:table-cell at lines 715-725. Caller provides neither mobilePresentation nor a detail/expand contract, so the source code supplies no mobile path to per-row provenance and timestamp.
issues.fix: Adopt DataTable's existing typed mobilePresentation/detail capability and expose all five fields on mobile while keeping compact name/value summaries, stable row keys, sort/filter/pagination and tableId. Do not merely remove metadata or add a competing mobile table.

issues.detail: All localized category ticks are forced at interval=0 with fontSize=11 in a narrow chart; long labels and compound-value table cells need clipping/overflow verification.
issues.fix: Exercise long labels and full raw values at all required widths; use existing chart sizing/axis policies and readable wrap/detail affordances without dropping categories.

sourceEvidence: Refresh, vehicle selection and search have localized aria-labels; icons are decorative (page:88-93; LiveSignalToolbar.tsx:64; LiveSignalsTable.tsx:181-195).
Summary and breakdowns are named sections; source bar has role=img and textual counts (page:110,124; LiveSignalSourceBreakdown.tsx:74-83,109-110).
Chart receives localized ariaLabel and dataColumns; fatal errors and retained warnings use existing feedback owners.

PageContainer has route-focus infrastructure and a central load-announcement hook, but page supplies query without loading/error flags (PageContainer.tsx:139-147; page:100-108). Actual announcement behavior needs integration review.

issues.detail: Refresh icon uses animate-spin while fetching; LiveIndicator also spins on reconnect. No page-level motion preference branch is supplied. Shared/global reduced-motion behavior was not exercised.
issues.fix: Verify existing motion suppression for FadeIn and CSS spins under OS reduced motion and low-bandwidth preferences; use current owners if an actual gap is confirmed.

states.initialLoading: Selected vehicle plus pending live query gives loading skeletons; brief masks missing measurements.
states.noVehicle: All sections remain present with selection guidance; refresh disabled. Fleet resolving/error can also appear as no vehicle because fleet trust metadata is not exposed.
states.empty: Resolved no-row snapshot gives empty panels and retry; a supplied empty signals object produces measured zero count metrics, absent signals produces unknown metrics.
states.fatalError: Only first-load fatal error replaces each dependent panel via QueryError.
states.retained: Rows survive failed/paused refresh and render retained notices/retry. Retained empty snapshots retain their empty body and retry.
states.ready: Snapshot rows, six metrics, source counts, kind chart and detail table.
states.offline: Query trust and global SSE status are independent. LiveIndicator can show Offline while REST still succeeds.
states.partial: Malformed/legacy entries degrade through row flattening and classification; there is no server completeness guarantee or independently fetched breakdown.
states.stale: Source-layer stale classification and query-refresh staleness are different; brief explicitly notes age independence.
states.runtime: All state branches inspected only, not exercised.

visualIssues.detail: Source track and count tiles use fixed white alpha backgrounds/borders at lines 106 and 132; source bars use emerald/amber/blue/slate-500 at lines 42-45. These are not theme-adaptive neutral surface/border tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border tokens and restrained semantic source colors. Preserve all proportions, labels and counts; computed inline width is valid and must remain.

visualIssues.detail: Raw values use fixed cyan-300/purple-300/amber-300 syntax colors and seven categorical badge mappings. These are toned down rather than neon, but numeric/boolean/string type is not inherently a warning/danger status; theme contrast is unmeasured.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer theme-aware neutral raw-value typography and restrained type cues. Keep the kind text and diagnostic raw values; do not conflate types with operational severity.

visualIssues.detail: Each categorical bar cycles the chartTokens.series palette, yielding up to seven hues without a severity distinction; chart cursor uses fixed white rgba at line 128 and panel icons are fixed cyan.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer one restrained theme-aware count-series accent with retained category labels and values. Keep saved chart palette choices where the shared chart supports them; avoid changing global palettes from a page audit.

architectureIssues.detail: Subtitle and no-data copy describe the endpoint exclusively as Redis cache, while injected owner and provenance metadata describe layered L1/L2/stale state. The empty message recommends vehicle publishing but an absent payload is not proof of an offline vehicle.
architectureIssues.fix: Describe the returned layered live snapshot accurately, distinguish absent snapshot from online status and retain troubleshooting as guidance, not asserted diagnosis.

architectureIssues.detail: Compact LiveIndicator is global SSE health while this page's source is foreground REST polling. With only Live/Offline labels it can be mistaken for selected vehicle or polling health.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain global connection visibility but label its SSE scope separately from query freshness and returned signal ages using existing metadata/typography. Do not replace the global hook or use SSE status to discard retained REST rows.

architectureIssues.detail: Fleet list is a prerequisite query, but hook returns only vehicles and selection. Its failure or pending state cannot be distinguished from an empty fleet by the local selector and no-vehicle panels.
architectureIssues.fix: Shared hook owner should provide additive prerequisite DataState/query metadata without changing selection precedence; page can then expose loading, retained fleet and retry instead of telling a failed-list user merely to select a vehicle.

priority.first: Preserve mobile per-row provenance/time reachability and independent prerequisite trust.
priority.next: Correct layered/SSE copy and reduce fixed-white, rainbow and type-severity presentation.
priority.reason: Existing architecture already preserves main sections and retained snapshot states. No runtime failure is claimed; source-confirmed mobile hiding and prerequisite recovery gaps merit implementation before visual acceptance.

competingImplementations.name: Old KPI band vs current OperationalBrief
competingImplementations.detail: Barrel still exports LiveSignalKpiBand; its six MetricCards coerce missing counts to zero. Mounted page instead imports LiveSignalsOperationalBrief and correctly uses hasSnapshot. This is an alternate implementation, not an additional mounted section.
competingImplementations.fix: Do not re-adopt the zero-default KPI path. Owner may check other callers before consolidating exports; no dead-code claim made.

competingImplementations.name: Local admin picker vs workspace vehicle owner
competingImplementations.detail: VEHICLE_DISABLED_PREFIXES includes /admin and RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS excludes /admin/live-signals. The page consumes canonical selection but legitimately renders its required local selector. This is not competing scope or an unauthorized second date picker.
competingImplementations.fix: Preserve local vehicle selection and current live-only scope; do not add range controls or remove selector merely to standardize the page.

sourceComposition.note: 1203 counts the 175-line page plus currently used toolbar, state, source/kind/table, stats, brief and metric helper. No source changes; therefore no reduction/parity claim against an earlier historical version.

actions: Choose vehicle via Select; preserve labels display_name -> VIN -> localized ID fallback, URL/store write-through and no-clear rule once selected.
Refresh snapshot manually; disabled without vehicle; fetching spin and localized accessible name.
Retry fatal, empty and retained source states; no prerequisite retry without a selected vehicle.
Filter signal names case-insensitively after trim.
Sort signal name and timestamp in either direction; invalid/missing timestamp sort uses stable numeric fallback.
Filter DataTable values using all loaded row candidates.
Paginate local rows, default 50, options 25/50/100; preserve tableId='admin:live-signals', name='live-signals' and row-name identity.

Preserve shared DataTable column visibility/width persistence and any currently available CSV/JSON controls; caller does not explicitly opt into export and shared defaults are conditional, so mounted export availability is unverified.
Inspect source/age tooltips, relative timestamps, kind chart tooltips and supplied chart data alternative.
Preserve OperationalBrief evidence/limitations and any existing shared details interaction; actual open behavior unverified.
dataBehavior: One-second foreground REST poll, hidden-tab pause, matching query staleTime, cancellation and QueryClient retry ownership.
All sections stay mounted as shells in no-vehicle/loading/empty/fatal/retained states; refresh failure must never erase usable rows.
Flatten envelopes and bare scalars; preserve name, raw value including null/boolean/compound data, kind, source, finite age_ms and timestamp/ts fallback.
Classify known kinds before JS fallback; normalize only source bucket identity, preserve raw row source; count zero buckets for sources and omit zero kind bars.
Raw diagnostic values are not silently converted, rounded or interpreted as unspecified physical units. Display-only freshest age maps ms to shared latency seconds and specialist notation.
Distinguish absent signals from supplied empty object; unknown age remains null/em dash; counts refer to returned snapshot before table filtering.
Keep server at assembly timestamp, independent signal age/source freshness, six metric descriptions, layered provenance and no-historical-completeness limitation.
Do not add historical API filtering, fake signals, browser token storage or production mutations.
